guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：AP1000 壓水式發電架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture
guides.concept: 以主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據解析AP1000 壓水式發電架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture through primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識汽輪島淨電。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱與熱容。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識自然循環支持。重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 建立被動與主動支援的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識核島與共用系統。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開設計與建造驗證。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify pwr heat source/steam generators in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbine-island net power in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify residual heat/capacitance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify natural-circulation support in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of passive and active support, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify nuclear-island shared systems in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify public design/build evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交核島與共用系統的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交公開設計與建造驗證的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交公開設計與建造驗證的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for nuclear-island shared systems.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for public design/build evidence.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for public design/build evidence.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：取得設計批准等同每個電廠已商轉。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Design approval means every plant is operating commercially.

guides.scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
guides.scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

related.title: ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據；ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構改以直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence; ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture centers on direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器與沸水與直接蒸汽路，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以公開設計與建造驗證為起點，設計一項能區分「主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據」與「直接蒸汽路徑及自然循環邊界」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare pwr heat source/steam generators with bwr/direct steam paths and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from public design/build evidence and propose an observation distinguishing primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence from direct steam paths and natural-circulation boundaries, including uncertainty.
